_comment: scan-retypeset book config. Copy to <book>/pipeline/config.json. All page numbers are 1-based PDF page indices. See skill/references/config.md for the full reference.
_panel_no_format_help: bare = '9  text' (number + gap); paren = '（9）text' (fullwidth parens); dot = '9. text' (number + period + space, e.g. 巴黎圣母院). Extraction is style-agnostic; the setting fixes the canonical re-typeset token.
_no_panel_no_help: panel-range pages that print NO leading number (e.g. an unnumbered prologue run): the number anchor check is skipped for them.

enhance._color_auto_help: auto = per-figure is_color_image detection (p99 chroma > 30 -> color_as_is). REQUIRED OVERRIDES: heavily YELLOWED gray scans must set "off" — the yellow cast alone pushes paper chroma past the threshold (刘秀 下册: paper chroma ≈ 70) and every figure would be kept yellow as-is; a figure with subtle color below the threshold can be forced with "on". Ignored when variant=vector (always B/W).
enhance._variant_help: bw_clear = grayscale cleaned scan (default for grayscale scans); vector = freshly-printed high-contrast black-and-white, detail-preserving (page-level illumination fit + local tone-relative binarize + potrace SVG master + 1-bit high-res raster). vector needs potrace + rsvg-convert (degrades gracefully without). COLOR-FIGURE RULE (default variant only, color_auto=auto): a figure with meaningful color (p99 per-pixel max(R,G,B)-min(R,G,B) > 30, lib.common.is_color_image) is auto-routed to color_as_is - original color placed 1:1, no pixel treatment at all; the print_fitness grayscale check is then skipped for the page.

vector._help: v2 detail-preserving local binarization. T_dark: global ink threshold (dark lines on light paper). T_solid: local tone below which the region is a dense tone -> flat black. dev: pixels darker than their local tone by this much are ink (halftone dots/lines of mid-tone, kept as pattern not solid). bright_dev: pixels brighter than local tone by this much are white detail (light lines carved into dark tone). tone_kernel: neighbourhood for the tone estimate. speckle_px: drop ink components smaller than this (scan noise). close: morphological closing radius to reconnect 1px line fragments. potrace_t: noise tolerance for the SVG master (2 keeps small dots; 5 drops them).

_margin_strip_help: crop + redraw the printed running design in the page margins 1:1 — right side (edge line / running-title tab / red seal) and LEFT side (small emblems, e.g. the 刘秀 horse mark). Both auto-detected per page; blank margins are skipped, so leave it on for books without margin design.
_watermark_boxes_help: Watermarks added by later (re)scanners, painted out of the deskewed page in 03_enhance (so figure + margin-strip crops come out clean) and their OCR line is dropped in 04_merge. List of normalized page boxes [x0,y0,x1,y1] (fractions of render W/H). Measure the watermark's ink bbox by pixel projection on several panel pages — a scan-time overlay is identical on every page, so one box covers the book. A line is dropped when its bbox CENTRE is inside a box AND it starts from the left 60% of the box's x span (real caption lines ending in the same corner start further right). 刘秀 下册 example: [[0.0, 0.842, 0.200, 0.993]] (horse + '天岸马奇通人中龙' slogan + thin underline, bottom-left, all panel pages). For special pages, add the same box to whiteout_boxes; a watermark sitting ON a colored banner image gets the image's `erase_tmpl` {"page": N, "boxes": [...]} (PREFERRED: template un-blending from a plain-paper page N — restores the underlying art, only the watermark shape is removed) with `erase_ink` (pixel-level dark-ink replacement) as fallback when no plain-paper page exists. See references/watermark.md.
